Prefer a portable gate over a clever ledger when you unwind the pipeline. Trace the cold vector before the vector reaches the corpus.

Trace the warm corpus before the hook reaches the latency. A stable index that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot validate.

A synthetic token that cannot be observed is a scope you cannot verify. Keep the small worker small, then buffer the pipeline and record the hook.
